en.title: Meda Billing
en.summary: Multi-tenant school billing and admissions (PPDB) for Indonesian foundations, written in Go.
en.about: Meda Billing connects foundations (yayasan), their schools, parents and students in one backend. It runs new-student admissions with forms each school can configure, then turns tuition (SPP) and other fees into recurring, one-time or instalment bills that parents pay online.
did: Helped set the stack and the architecture: Go with Echo, PostgreSQL through GORM, Redis for sessions, cache and the task queue, split into domain, repository, usecase and handler layers.
Integrated Xendit for online payments, then migrated the whole payment flow to DOKU on my own.
Build backend modules and REST APIs where every money value goes through shopspring/decimal, never a float.
en.noDemo: No public demo link to share yet.

id_.title: Meda Billing
id_.summary: Billing dan pendaftaran siswa baru (PPDB) multi-tenant untuk yayasan sekolah di Indonesia, ditulis dengan Go.
id_.about: Meda Billing menghubungkan yayasan, sekolah-sekolahnya, orang tua, dan siswa dalam satu backend. Aplikasi ini menjalankan PPDB dengan formulir yang bisa diatur tiap sekolah, lalu mengubah SPP dan biaya lain menjadi tagihan rutin, sekali bayar, atau cicilan yang dibayar orang tua secara online.
did: Ikut menentukan stack dan arsitekturnya: Go dengan Echo, PostgreSQL lewat GORM, Redis untuk session, cache, dan antrean task, dibagi ke layer domain, repository, usecase, dan handler.
Mengintegrasikan Xendit untuk pembayaran online, lalu memigrasikan seluruh alur pembayaran ke DOKU sendiri.
Membangun modul backend dan REST API yang semua nilai uangnya lewat shopspring/decimal, tidak pernah float.
id_.noDemo: Belum ada link demo publik yang bisa dibagikan.

en.title: Waras
en.summary: A telemedicine app where your first consultation is with an AI.
en.about: Waras is a health consultation app built around AI. People describe what they're dealing with and get a consultation from an AI. I work on the Go backend behind it.
did: Had a say in choosing the tech stack and the architecture.
Build backend services and APIs in Go, with Redis alongside.
en.noDemo: No public demo link to share yet.

id_.title: Waras
id_.summary: Aplikasi telemedicine tempat konsultasi pertamamu dilakukan dengan AI.
id_.about: Waras adalah aplikasi konsultasi kesehatan yang dibangun di sekitar AI. Pengguna menceritakan keluhannya lalu mendapat konsultasi dari AI. Saya mengerjakan backend Go di baliknya.
did: Ikut menentukan tech stack dan arsitekturnya.
Membangun service dan API backend dengan Go, didampingi Redis.
id_.noDemo: Belum ada link demo publik yang bisa dibagikan.

en.title: AYO Kasir by SRC
en.summary: POS and retail microservices for PT HM Sampoerna's store network.
en.about: AYO Kasir is the point-of-sale side of Sampoerna's retail program: shops run their sales and stock through it, and wholesale partners plug into the same system. I worked on the Laravel services behind it as part of the Weekend Inc. team.
did: Built and maintained the staff, coach and order modules.
Hunted down N+1 queries and reworked indexes on the slow endpoints.
Set up Husky, Commitlint and diff-based linting so bad commits get stopped before review.
Shipped through Jenkins pipelines to AWS.

id_.title: AYO Kasir by SRC
id_.summary: Microservice POS dan ritel untuk jaringan toko PT HM Sampoerna.
id_.about: AYO Kasir adalah sisi kasir dari program ritel Sampoerna: toko menjalankan penjualan dan stoknya di sini, dan mitra grosir tersambung ke sistem yang sama. Saya dulu mengerjakan service Laravel di baliknya sebagai bagian dari tim Weekend Inc.
did: Membangun dan merawat modul staf, coach, dan order.
Memburu query N+1 dan menata ulang index di endpoint yang lambat.
Memasang Husky, Commitlint, dan linting berbasis diff supaya commit yang bermasalah tertahan sebelum review.
Deploy lewat pipeline Jenkins ke AWS.

en.title: AYO Qoncierge by SRC
en.summary: Operations platform for field coaches and staff, with roles and audit trails.
en.about: Field coaches and the staff they look after use Qoncierge across Sampoerna's retail network, so it needs clear permissions and a record of who changed what. The codebase follows clean architecture, which keeps each domain in its own lane.
did: Designed service layers with clear domain boundaries and dependency inversion.
Built role-based authorization for staff and coaching personnel.
Added structured audit logs and error handling around critical changes.
Kept the REST contracts stable for the frontend and third-party consumers.
en.noDemo: Internal platform, so there's no public demo.

id_.title: AYO Qoncierge by SRC
id_.summary: Platform operasional untuk coach lapangan dan staf, dengan peran dan jejak audit.
id_.about: Coach lapangan dan staf yang mereka dampingi memakai Qoncierge di seluruh jaringan ritel Sampoerna, jadi aplikasinya butuh izin akses yang jelas dan catatan siapa mengubah apa. Kodenya mengikuti clean architecture supaya tiap domain tetap di jalurnya sendiri.
did: Merancang service layer dengan batas domain yang jelas dan dependency inversion.
Membangun otorisasi berbasis peran untuk staf dan coach.
Menambahkan audit log terstruktur dan error handling di sekitar perubahan kritis.
Menjaga kontrak REST tetap stabil untuk frontend dan konsumen pihak ketiga.
id_.noDemo: Platform internal, jadi tidak ada demo publik.

en.title: Multi-Currency E-Wallet
en.summary: Ledger-based wallet API where money never touches a JavaScript float.
en.about: A backend for wallets in several currencies, built around a ledger table in PostgreSQL. Top-ups, payments and same-currency transfers each run inside one database transaction, and a retried request with the same Idempotency-Key gets the original response back instead of charging twice.
did: Did all money math with decimal.js and stored amounts as NUMERIC(20,2), rounded half-up to two places.
Locked rows with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE, and locked transfer wallets in sorted ID order so two transfers can't deadlock each other.
Added composite and partial indexes for the ledger pages and active-wallet lookups.
Documented every endpoint with OpenAPI 3 and Swagger UI.
en.noDemo: API only; it runs locally with Swagger UI at /api-docs.

id_.title: E-Wallet Multi-Mata-Uang
id_.summary: API dompet berbasis ledger yang uangnya tidak pernah lewat float JavaScript.
id_.about: Backend untuk dompet digital dengan beberapa mata uang, dibangun di atas tabel ledger di PostgreSQL. Top-up, pembayaran, dan transfer sesama mata uang masing-masing berjalan dalam satu transaksi database, dan request ulang dengan Idempotency-Key yang sama mendapat respons aslinya tanpa menagih dua kali.
did: Semua hitungan uang pakai decimal.js dan disimpan sebagai NUMERIC(20,2), dibulatkan half-up ke dua desimal.
Mengunci baris dengan SELECT ... FOR UPDATE, dan mengunci dompet saat transfer berdasarkan urutan ID supaya dua transfer tidak saling deadlock.
Menambahkan index komposit dan parsial untuk halaman ledger dan pencarian dompet aktif.
Mendokumentasikan semua endpoint dengan OpenAPI 3 dan Swagger UI.
id_.noDemo: Hanya API; dijalankan lokal dengan Swagger UI di /api-docs.

en.title: Order Management System
en.summary: Order API in Go with clean architecture and a background worker.
en.about: An order API written in Go on the standard library's net/http, with no web framework. New orders are saved as PENDING and handed to a background worker through a buffered channel, so the HTTP request returns right away while processing carries on.
did: Split the code into handler, service and repository layers that only talk to each other through interfaces.
Validated the user and the product at the same time with goroutines and a WaitGroup.
Added JWT auth with bcrypt-hashed passwords, plus Swagger docs generated by swag.
en.noDemo: API only; it runs locally with Swagger UI.

id_.title: Order Management System
id_.summary: API order dengan Go, clean architecture, dan worker di background.
id_.about: API order yang ditulis dengan Go di atas net/http bawaan, tanpa web framework. Order baru disimpan sebagai PENDING lalu diserahkan ke worker di background lewat buffered channel, jadi request HTTP langsung selesai sementara prosesnya jalan terus.
did: Memisahkan kode ke layer handler, service, dan repository yang hanya berkomunikasi lewat interface.
Memvalidasi user dan produk secara bersamaan dengan goroutine dan WaitGroup.
Menambahkan autentikasi JWT dengan password ber-hash bcrypt, plus dokumentasi Swagger dari swag.
id_.noDemo: Hanya API; dijalankan lokal dengan Swagger UI.

en.title: MoneyMate
en.summary: Personal finance app with AI receipt scanning and budgets that roll over.
en.about: A personal finance web app with a React front end and an Express API. You snap a receipt, Gemini Vision pulls out what you bought, and whatever budget you didn't spend rolls over into next month.
did: Wrote the carry-over budget engine and the period balance math.
Connected Gemini Vision to read receipts automatically.
Added rate limiting, JWT revocation and HPP protection to the API.
Deployed the front end on Netlify and the API in a container with a persistent database.

id_.title: MoneyMate
id_.summary: Aplikasi keuangan pribadi dengan scan struk berbasis AI dan anggaran yang terbawa ke bulan berikutnya.
id_.about: Aplikasi web keuangan pribadi dengan front end React dan API Express. Foto struknya, Gemini Vision membaca apa saja yang kamu beli, dan sisa anggaran yang tidak terpakai pindah ke bulan berikutnya.
did: Menulis mesin anggaran carry-over dan perhitungan saldo per periode.
Menyambungkan Gemini Vision untuk membaca struk secara otomatis.
Menambahkan rate limiting, pencabutan JWT, dan proteksi HPP di API.
Deploy front end di Netlify dan API di container dengan database persisten.

en.title: Synn Store
en.summary: Game top-up store for players in Malaysia, paid through webhooks that never count the same payment twice.
en.about: Synn Store sells game vouchers and top-ups for Mobile Legends, Genshin Impact and more, with no account needed. I built it as a freelancer. Payments arrive through webhooks, so every handler checks whether it has already seen that payment before it touches an order.
did: Wrote idempotent webhook handlers so retries never double-credit an order.
Tuned indexes for order lookups and the transaction reports.
Built the admin panel for sales, stock and invoices.

id_.title: Synn Store
id_.summary: Toko top-up game untuk pemain di Malaysia, dibayar lewat webhook yang tidak pernah menghitung pembayaran yang sama dua kali.
id_.about: Synn Store menjual voucher dan top-up game seperti Mobile Legends dan Genshin Impact tanpa perlu membuat akun. Saya membangunnya sebagai freelancer. Pembayaran masuk lewat webhook, jadi setiap handler mengecek dulu apakah pembayaran itu pernah diproses sebelum menyentuh order.
did: Menulis webhook handler yang idempoten supaya retry tidak pernah menambah saldo order dua kali.
Menyetel index untuk pencarian order dan laporan transaksi.
Membangun panel admin untuk penjualan, stok, dan invoice.

en.title: IndoOptik
en.summary: Optical shop catalog where checkout happens on WhatsApp.
en.about: A catalog for an optical shop: customers pick frames, configure their lenses, fill a cart and finish the order in a WhatsApp chat with the shop. There's deliberately no in-app payment; the admin side covers products, promo codes, testimonials and site settings.
did: Built the storefront, the lens options and a session-based cart.
Wrote WhatsApp checkout for both orders and appointment bookings.
Added a security headers middleware for CSP, frame protection, referrer and permissions policy.
Packaged it in Docker with PHP-FPM, Nginx and MySQL for a VPS.

id_.title: IndoOptik
id_.summary: Katalog toko optik yang checkout-nya lewat WhatsApp.
id_.about: Katalog untuk toko optik: pelanggan memilih frame, mengatur lensanya, mengisi keranjang, lalu menyelesaikan pesanan lewat chat WhatsApp dengan toko. Sengaja tidak ada pembayaran di aplikasi; sisi admin mengurus produk, kode promo, testimoni, dan pengaturan situs.
did: Membangun etalase, pilihan lensa, dan keranjang berbasis session.
Menulis checkout WhatsApp untuk pesanan dan booking janji temu.
Menambahkan middleware security header untuk CSP, proteksi frame, referrer, dan permissions policy.
Mengemas aplikasi di Docker dengan PHP-FPM, Nginx, dan MySQL untuk VPS.

en.title: Vehicle Booking · PT NikelIndo Mining
en.summary: Company vehicle bookings for a nickel mine, approved level by level.
en.about: A web app for booking and monitoring company vehicles at a nickel mining company. An admin books a vehicle and a driver and picks at least two approvers; the request only reaches the next level once the level before it says yes, and one rejection anywhere closes it.
did: Built the multi-level approval flow, where each approver unlocks the next one.
Made a dashboard with four Chart.js charts, including bookings per month and fuel use.
Added vehicle and driver management with report export.
en.noDemo: No public demo; it runs locally with seeded accounts.

id_.title: Pemesanan Kendaraan · PT NikelIndo Mining
id_.summary: Pemesanan kendaraan perusahaan tambang nikel dengan persetujuan berjenjang.
id_.about: Aplikasi web untuk memesan dan memantau kendaraan di perusahaan tambang nikel. Admin memesan kendaraan dan driver lalu memilih minimal dua approver; permintaan baru naik ke level berikutnya setelah level sebelumnya setuju, dan satu penolakan di level mana pun langsung menutupnya.
did: Membangun alur persetujuan berjenjang, di mana setiap approver membuka giliran approver berikutnya.
Membuat dashboard dengan empat grafik Chart.js, termasuk pemesanan per bulan dan konsumsi BBM.
Menambahkan manajemen kendaraan dan driver beserta export laporan.
id_.noDemo: Tidak ada demo publik; dijalankan lokal dengan akun hasil seeder.

en.title: SIMABIMA
en.summary: Digital archive system you browse the same way the office is organised.
en.about: SIMABIMA stores archive documents and lets people find them by following the organisation chart: group, unit, sub-unit, then the archive table itself. Administrators manage everything, while staff can browse, download and upload their own files.
did: Modelled the unit hierarchy so the archive tree mirrors the real organisation.
Built upload, edit and download, with a download counter on every document.
Added a stats dashboard with monthly uploads and the most downloaded files, plus password reset by email.
en.noDemo: No public demo; it runs locally with a seeded admin account.

id_.title: SIMABIMA
id_.summary: Sistem arsip digital yang dijelajahi sesuai struktur organisasi kantornya.
id_.about: SIMABIMA menyimpan dokumen arsip dan membantu orang menemukannya dengan mengikuti struktur organisasi: grup, unit, sub unit, lalu tabel arsipnya. Administrator mengelola semuanya, sedangkan staf bisa menjelajah, mengunduh, dan mengunggah arsip mereka sendiri.
did: Memodelkan hierarki unit supaya pohon arsip sama dengan struktur organisasi aslinya.
Membangun fitur unggah, ubah, dan unduh, dengan penghitung unduhan di setiap dokumen.
Menambahkan dashboard statistik berisi unggahan per bulan dan dokumen terpopuler, plus reset password lewat email.
id_.noDemo: Tidak ada demo publik; dijalankan lokal dengan akun admin hasil seeder.

en.title: Lembah Outdoor Surabaya
en.summary: Camping gear rental with travel-app style date picking and live stock.
en.about: A rental site for camping and hiking gear in Surabaya. You pick a pick-up and return date the way you would on a travel app, the price follows tiered rental packages, and anything that runs out can't be added to the cart.
did: Built the date-range picker and the tiered pricing, including a weekend rule where Saturday to Sunday counts as one day.
Added product variants for shoe sizes, clothing sizes and colours, each with its own stock indicator.
Made a payment simulator with QRIS and virtual account options so checkout can be walked through end to end.

id_.title: Lembah Outdoor Surabaya
id_.summary: Persewaan alat camping dengan pemilihan tanggal ala aplikasi travel dan stok real-time.
id_.about: Situs persewaan alat camping dan hiking di Surabaya. Kamu memilih tanggal ambil dan kembali seperti di aplikasi travel, harganya mengikuti paket sewa berjenjang, dan barang yang habis tidak bisa masuk keranjang.
did: Membangun pemilih rentang tanggal dan tarif berjenjang, termasuk aturan akhir pekan di mana Sabtu sampai Minggu dihitung satu hari.
Menambahkan varian produk untuk ukuran sepatu, ukuran pakaian, dan warna, masing-masing dengan indikator stok sendiri.
Membuat simulator pembayaran dengan opsi QRIS dan virtual account supaya alur checkout bisa dicoba dari awal sampai akhir.

en.title: Desa Banteng Putih Website
en.summary: Village website with an admin panel for news, products and services.
en.about: The website for Banteng Putih village. News, local products, services, the gallery and testimonials all come from a Filament admin panel, so changing content doesn't need any code.
did: Built the admin panel with Filament and the interactive pages and forms with Livewire.
Handled image and file uploads through Spatie Media Library.

id_.title: Website Desa Banteng Putih
id_.summary: Website desa dengan panel admin untuk berita, produk, dan layanan.
id_.about: Website untuk Desa Banteng Putih. Berita, produk lokal, layanan, galeri, dan testimoni semuanya diatur dari panel admin Filament, jadi mengganti konten tidak perlu menyentuh kode.
did: Membangun panel admin dengan Filament serta halaman dan form interaktif dengan Livewire.
Menangani unggahan gambar dan file lewat Spatie Media Library.

en.title: RAG for the Alpro Lab Module
en.summary: Ask questions about Telkom University's Alpro lab module and get answers from the module itself.
en.about: A retrieval-augmented generation pipeline over the Algoritma & Pemrograman lab module from Telkom University. The module is split into overlapping chunks, embedded and stored in FAISS; each question pulls the three closest chunks, and Llama 3.3 70B on Groq answers from them.
did: Converted the module into TXT and JSONL, then chunked it at size 500 with an overlap of 100.
Embedded the chunks with a multilingual MiniLM model and searched them by cosine similarity in FAISS.
Wrote a notebook that runs in Google Colab or local Jupyter.
en.noDemo: No hosted demo; the notebook runs in Colab with your own Groq key.

id_.title: RAG Modul Praktikum Alpro
id_.summary: Tanya jawab soal modul praktikum Alpro Telkom University, dijawab dari isi modulnya sendiri.
id_.about: Pipeline retrieval-augmented generation untuk modul praktikum Algoritma & Pemrograman Telkom University. Modulnya dipecah jadi potongan yang saling tumpang tindih, di-embed, lalu disimpan di FAISS; setiap pertanyaan mengambil tiga potongan terdekat, dan Llama 3.3 70B di Groq menjawab berdasarkan potongan itu.
did: Mengubah modul ke TXT dan JSONL, lalu memotongnya dengan ukuran 500 dan overlap 100.
Meng-embed potongan dengan model MiniLM multibahasa dan mencarinya dengan cosine similarity di FAISS.
Menulis notebook yang bisa jalan di Google Colab maupun Jupyter lokal.
id_.noDemo: Tidak ada demo online; notebook-nya bisa dijalankan di Colab dengan Groq key sendiri.

en.title: Premier League 2025/26 Dashboard
en.summary: Interactive stats dashboard for the 2025/26 Premier League season.
en.about: Standings, goal records, player leaderboards and club profiles for the 2025/26 Premier League in one single-page app. Click a club in the table and it jumps straight to that club's profile.
did: Built the points chart with Champions League, Europa League and relegation zones marked.
Added Golden Boot and assist leaderboards.
Calculated win rate, draw rate and goals per match for every club profile.

id_.title: Dashboard Premier League 2025/26
id_.summary: Dashboard statistik interaktif untuk musim Premier League 2025/26.
id_.about: Klasemen, rekor gol, papan peringkat pemain, dan profil klub Premier League 2025/26 dalam satu aplikasi single-page. Klik satu klub di tabel dan halaman langsung pindah ke profil klub itu.
did: Membangun grafik poin dengan zona Liga Champions, Liga Europa, dan degradasi.
Menambahkan papan peringkat top skor dan assist.
Menghitung persentase menang, persentase seri, dan rata-rata gol per pertandingan untuk setiap profil klub.
